recognize_zh: 周邊血液的淋巴球核分成兩葉（雙核樣、binucleated/lobated lymphocyte），細胞質淡藍；骨髓切片 CD20 免疫染色可見竇內（intrasinusoidal）B 細胞排列，這是持續性多株 B 淋巴球增多症（PPBL）的典型組合。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with a bilobed nucleus giving a binucleate appearance
Moderately condensed chromatin and a rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Otherwise unremarkable red cells in the background
Bone marrow biopsy immunostain (B-cell marker, likely CD20): linear clusters of positive cells within sinusoids (intrasinusoidal pattern)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a deeply cleaved, bilobed nucleus producing a binucleate appearance, with mature chromatin and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow biopsy highlights B cells arranged in linear aggregates within sinusoids. In a patient with lymphocytosis, these findings are suggestive of persistent polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis, typically seen in young female smokers with HLA-DR7, polyclonal IgM elevation and isochromosome 3q; polyclonality should be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Also shows intrasinusoidal marrow infiltration, but cells are villous lymphocytes with monotypic light-chain restriction rather than polyclonal binucleated lymphocytes.
CLL cells are small round lymphocytes with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, CD5+/CD23+ and light-chain restricted.
ATLL cells have multilobated flower-like nuclei and are CD4+ T cells with HTLV-1 serology, not polyclonal B cells.
Shows hairy cytoplasmic projections, CD11c/CD25/CD103 and BRAF V600E with diffuse fried-egg marrow infiltrate, not bilobed nuclei.
